files.description: Repository conventions: build/test/lint commands, integration-test setup (build tag, docker-compose, RabbitMQ 4), backward-compatibility and godoc requirements.
Package-level overview: connection/publisher/consumer usage, declarative topology and its re-declaration behavior, middleware.
Sentinel errors (ErrConnectionClosed, ErrNack, ErrRequeue, ErrDrop, ...) and Connection's reconnection/backoff logic that every other file builds on.

Keep-a-Changelog history, including detailed incident write-ups for two real concurrency bugs (0.13.0 topology loss, 0.14.0 Close/Start race) that motivate several review rules — see .greptile/rules.md.
The linter ruleset already enforced in CI; note revive's 'exported' check is deliberately disabled here, so godoc-on-export is not caught by lint.
